events.title: Chaos Coin in October Next Fest
events.summary: Hi, all! Just a quick announcement:Chaos Coin will be participating in the Steam Next Fest, starting next week on October 19th!I have a major update to the game that will be released just in time for the event, so please look forward to it! Your support means a lot, and I'd love for you to try the demo if you haven't already or to give it another play if you have.

events.title: Update (version 0.3.3) - Maps and Towns
events.summary: Hi, all! I have an assortment of additions and changes coming in this new version.I’ve gotten a lot of feedback that the Town events are confusing or frustrating, so I’ve made some revisions and added a new section of the tutorial that will hopefully clear that up. I’ve also broken up the Market space into three separate map space types, which should result in more varied maps with more choices to make.If you’ve already played before, you might also notice a new addition to the character roster!

events.title: Patch Notes (version 0.3.2) - Input remapping
events.summary: Hi, all! I’m chugging along on some new coins for the main game, but in the meantime I’ve gotten some useful fixes and features that are now in the demo.The main thing is input remapping!
